package main

import (
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"

 "retrom/internal/capability/runtime/runtimecatalog"
)

func main() {
 raw, err := os.ReadFile("data/runtime-target-bindings/v1/catalog.json")
 must(err)
 catalog, err := runtimecatalog.ParseCatalog(raw)
 must(err)
 normalized, err := json.Marshal(catalog)
 must(err)
 samples := map[string]any{
  "zero-catalog": runtimecatalog.Catalog{},
  "empty-catalog": runtimecatalog.Catalog{
   Definitions: runtimecatalog.Definitions{
    Platforms: []runtimecatalog.PlatformDefinition{}, Cores: []runtimecatalog.CoreDefinition{},
    ContentKinds: []string{}, AssetPacks: []runtimecatalog.AssetPackDefinition{},
   },
   Bindings: []runtimecatalog.Binding{},
  },
  "zero-binding": runtimecatalog.Binding{},
  "empty-binding": runtimecatalog.Binding{PlatformIDs: []string{}, AcceptedContentKinds: []string{}},
  "asset-pack-unicode": runtimecatalog.AssetPackDefinition{
   ID: "extra-assets", Kind: "ADDITIONAL_ASSETS", Generation: "RPGXP", DeclaredName: "Ｓtraße",
   NormalizedDeclaredName: "strasse", DisplayName: "Extra <&> assets", RequiredLayoutVersion: "mkxpz-v1", Enabled: true,
  },
  "platform": runtimecatalog.PlatformDefinition{ID: "platform", Name: "Retrom <&> 游戏", SortOrder: 7},
  "core": runtimecatalog.CoreDefinition{ID: "core", Name: "Core", Enabled: true},
 }
 encodings := make(map[string]string, len(samples))
 for key, value := range samples {
  encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
  must(err)
  encodings[key] = string(encoded)
 }
 result := map[string]any{
  "source": "pre-move runtimecatalog six-type Go implementation",
  "rawCatalogSHA256": digest(raw), "normalizedCatalogJSON": string(normalized), "normalizedCatalogSHA256": digest(normalized),
  "samples": encodings,
 }
 output, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
 must(err)
 must(os.WriteFile(os.Args[1], append(output, '\n'), 0o600))
}
func digest(value []byte) string {
 sum := sha256.Sum256(value)
 return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func must(err error) { if err != nil { panic(err) } }
